verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs describe creating backups of serverless indexes through the SDK, API, or console, both to protect data and to copy indexes. Backups also appear in the production security overview. Restore is implied by the index-copying use case rather than shown as an explicit restore workflow, and the feature is scoped to serverless indexes. Missing for 10: explicit restore-from-backup documentation, coverage beyond serverless indexes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
